text: Bridge to peer intent-graph tools instead of competing: find which of Coherence, convergentAI, OpenIntent, IntentLang, sigil, agent-spec has real users, and link their intents into Aimparency graphs
description: Major hypothesis loop 2026-11-22. RESEARCHED: several open projects now link intent to agent work in a graph: Coherence (opencollective.com/coherence: product intent, specs, acceptance criteria, code changes and verification evidence in one versioned graph, hosted by Open Source Europe), convergentAI (pypi.org/project/convergentAI: agents publish intents to a shared append-only graph and check overlaps before building; one maintainer), and the PyPI/CLI packages openintent, intentgraph, IntentLang (krakenhavoc.github.io/IntentLang), sigil (fielding.github.io/sigil), agent-spec (github.com/ZhangHanDong/agent-spec). OBSERVED: Aimparency already imports GitHub issues and spec-kit tasks (import_github_issues, import_spec_tasks) and has an A2A boundary waiting on a real exchange (6c611056). INFERRED: an open intention network grows by linking graphs, so each peer's users are potential participants rather than competitors. Smallest step: a one-page comparison (data model, license, activity, downloads or stars, whether agents write to it), no code; build an importer only for a peer with real usage, and approach its maintainers with appreciation first (relationship principle on 3d868d5b).

status.comment: Comparison done 2026-11-22 (GitHub API, pypistats.org): intent-graph peers have almost no users. convergentAI 29 downloads/month, intentgraph 33, openintent 104; krakenhavoc/IntentLang 4 stars (last push 2026-03), fielding/sigil 0 stars, fireharp/coherence 6 stars (a drift detector, not the Open Collective 'Coherence', whose repository I could not find). The one tool with traction is ZhangHanDong/agent-spec (464 stars, 35 forks, MIT, pushed 2026-08-29), but it is a per-task BDD spec verification tool, not an intent graph with values or connections. So no peer has an intent network worth bridging; refuted by its own criterion. Narrow follow-up if ever wanted: agent-spec specs could be read like import_spec_tasks reads spec-kit tasks, or used as acceptance checks in the harness verify stage. Not created as an idea: no demand seen.
